 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Aljamain Sterling and Kevin Vallejos meet in the co-feature of UFC Fight Night 294 at ABHA Arena in Doha, Qatar. Check out this quick breakdown of the matchup from MMA Junkie analyst Dan Tom. 
 Last event's results: 1-3-1
 UFC main cards, 2026: 126-82-2
 Aljamain Sterling vs. Kevin Vallejos UFC Fight Night 294 preview
 Sterling (26-5 MMA, 18-5 UFC) enters on the heels of back-to-back wins over Brian Ortega and Youssef Zalal. The former bantamweight champ's last setback came against Movsar Evloev nearly two years ago.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Vallejos (18-1 MMA, 4-0 UFC) brings a seven-fight winning streak into the biggest fight of his career thus far. He's won three of his four UFC fights by stoppage, with the most recent being Josh Emmett in March.
 Aljamain Sterling vs. Kevin Vallejos UFC Fight Night 294 expert pick, prediction
 The co-main event features an important fight for the featherweight division between Aljamain Sterling and Kevin Vallejos.
 Sterling, who was the former bantamweight champion, has done quite well for himself since moving up to 145 pounds. And if Sterling can get a win over another young up-and-comer this weekend, then the "Funk Master" will be sitting pretty as far as his featherweight title aspirations go.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement I suspect that Sterling accepted this fight for a reason, but Vallejos is a fighter who can flip anyone's fortune while he's on his feet.
 A boxing-centric striker, Vallejos brings everything from beautiful bodywork to solid combinations. That said, we've yet to see Vallejos face high-level grapplers and wrestlers who can put him in negative positions.
 Although Sterling could end up being another aging fighter for Vallejos to feast on, I can't help but side with the more proven product in Sterling to secure his title shot by finding a finish via rear-naked choke in Round 2. 
 Watch UFC Fight Night 294 with Paramount+ 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Aljamain Sterling vs. Kevin Vallejos UFC Fight Night 294 odds
 The oddsmakers and the public slightly favor the Argentinian fighter, listing Vallejos -134 and Sterling +110 via FanDuel.
 Aljamain Sterling vs. Kevin Vallejos UFC Fight Night 294 start time, how to watch
 Hooker and Ortega are expected to walk to the cage at approximately 1:40 p.m. ET. The fight streams live on Paramount+ .
